title: Kansas Resident Admits To Draining Over $30,000 From Multiple Bank Accounts in Maine
summary:

Rachael Kennedy, 37, targeted institutions in Penobscot and Aroostook counties, reports Fox Bangor. In October of 2025 she posed as customers and withdrew $30,400 from home equity lines of credit. Police chased her […]
The post Kansas Resident Admits To Draining Over $30,000 From Multiple Bank Accounts in Maine appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: A Kansas resident has pleaded guilty to stealing over $30,000 from multiple bank accounts in Maine. The individual used counterfeit identification to impersonate account holders and withdrew funds from locations in Penobscot and Aroostook counties. Local law enforcement investigated the incidents, which involved unauthorized withdrawals from home equity lines of credit.

The post AI Takes the First Step in Shopping While Consumers Keep the Buy Button appeared first on PYMNTS.com.
content: A recent PYMNTS Intelligence report reveals that consumers who use artificial intelligence to discover new retailers tend to spend significantly more than the average AI-assisted shopper.
